description: Canonical definition of the ledger entry (delivery) state machine, per docs/development-policy.md section 2.2. An entry is created at the initial state when the ledger accepts a message; the transient pre-validation state 'received' is never stored and is not part of this machine. Terminal states have no outgoing transitions: a blocked, unknown, failed or cancelled delivery is superseded by new messages, never revived by a transition. The implementation (LEDGER_TRANSITIONS in @agent-plaza/core) and its observable behavior are pinned to this file by the conformance tests.
